newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Oct 23 coffee auction to total 69,783 bags.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Oct 23 coffee auction to total 69,783 bags.

text.p: Brazil's government will auction 69,783 60-kg bags of coffee stocks in its next monthly auction Oct 23, a Banco do Brasil official said.
The coffee will be sold in 11 lots and is from harvests ranging from 1986/87 to 1987/88, she added.

The auction will be the largest in a series of monthly sales planned for this coffee year (July/June) but is still below the minimum 100,000 bags requested by roasters who argue the recently harvested 1996/97 crop is too young for blends.
